 India are in New Zealand for the first T20I of the five-match series at Hagley Oval, Christchurch, on Thursday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The series will continue till November 1, with fixtures being played across four stadiums in New Zealand.
 For India, Shreyas Iyer will act as skipper, with Tilak Varma as his deputy, and for the host nation, Mitchell Santner will lead the side.
 Here's everything you need to know about New Zealand vs. India, including TV channel and streaming options for the opening T20 match.
 New Zealand vs. India live stream, TV channel in the US and Canada
 Here's how to watch this T20 match in the United States and Canada:
 TV Channel: Willow TV
 Live Stream: Fubo , Fubo Canada 
 Fans in the United States and Canada will be able to watch this game live exclusively on Willow TV .
